# John T. Marcante | Technology Leadership Solutions

Canonical website: https://techleadersolutions.github.io/
Media archive: https://techleadersolutions.github.io/media.html

## Identity
John T. Marcante is a former Global CIO and Managing Director of Vanguard, U.S. CIO-in-Residence at Deloitte, Chair of Deloitte's CIO Advisory Council, and founder of Technology Leadership Solutions, LLC.

## Areas of expertise
Technology strategy; enterprise transformation; artificial intelligence and AI governance; cybersecurity and technology risk; operating model transformation; financial services and wealth management; executive leadership; board advisory; CIO coaching and development.

## Current work
Technology Leadership Solutions provides executive advisory, leadership coaching, speaking, board perspectives, and strategic consulting. John also advises senior executives and boards through his work with Deloitte and other advisory roles.
